args.message: Hi Sara - Tidewater Freight invoice TF-75496 (doc 5100006587, 34,920.50 USD) has already been paid. It went out in yesterday's payment run F110-0330-A as payment PAY-2026-04371, in bank file BF-20260330-01. Harbor Bank accepted the file with value date 2026-03-30, and the debit of -34,920.50 to Tidewater Freight is on our 2026-03-30 bank statement. I did not send a second payment because that would pay them twice. Tidewater may simply not have applied the funds yet. You can send them the payment reference PAY-2026-04371 and the 30 March value date so they can match it on their side. Let me know if they still can't find it.
